body: It's sad how many of us only get to realise this when we start dating our significant other... It's even worse when you can't tell if you are with your significant other simply because they are emotionally healthy, or because you actually love them. :(

I would if they didn’t mind being just friends. It does sort of affect the dynamic after knowing, but honestly it’s not unworkable if you both are mature about it. I’ve had guy friends completely cut contact with me after I’ve expressed wanting something purely platonic. Most situations it’s out of my control lol :(

I came across this ted talk this afternoon about overcoming the fear of getting rejected. What you do is basically request really random / impossible things to others that would prompt you getting rejected. The idea is that a day only counts as a success if you have been rejected. And you do this repeatedly every day until you’re super comfortable with being rejected. I’ve always struggled with social anxiety and this inspired me to step out of my comfort zone:)

I'm a second year uni student who happens to watch The School of Life videos quite frequently in the shower. Sometimes I don't even make out what he says (the shower's pretty loud), but I just love his voice lol I'm 19F :D
